games.rv:
SR3 did not shy away from doing everything and anything in its power to be wacky and derailed but that is what made this so much amazing. 
The writing, the story, the characters, the mechanics, .... its an experience. It helps it stand out as a game that took confidence in being what it was and nailed it. 
Its not everyday one can have an enjoyable experience of this level.

This is where the famous Saints Row franchise was born. 
While it may be a GTA knockoff, it managed to build its own personality, and for me, that was way better than the whole GTA experience. 
It connects you, it delivers a personalized experience. It makes you feel like part of something big. Even if the game was a normal gang war game (with enjoyable mechanics, storyline, characters and witty writing) the game stands apart. 
This was the introduction for me to what would become my favorite gaming franchise of all time.

While its a shame that they reused the map of SR3, 
it doesn't change the fact that this game is so hella fun and crazy with superpowers, aliens and just all out craziness. An open world superhero experience is not your everyday thing. The DLC Gat out of hell is an even crazier experience. 
While the final outcome was not what the original developers had in mind, it was still nevertheless an amazing experience. 
I just wish we got more.

paras: SatsugaiDeAtsu aka Satsu here. I have a chuni history with how I came to love anime. Currently, I am a student of psychology and am trying my best to be an established clinical psychologist. I am married to the woman I fell in love with. My life is going great. I may not find as much time to watch anime as before but I try to make the most of it. I watch anime with my wife so most of my time is spent in re-watching shows and exploring them with her. I love to watch films that provoke some thought as well as some good video gaming here and there. I do not write or sketch like I used to but I would love to take my pen up again sometimes. In life, all your wishes cannot come true, and while I could not be a mega weeb like I wished to be, I did become a respectable man who was able to accomplish a bunch of his life goals. And I'm proud of myself for that, even if the journey had miserable moments, the entire process together makes me feel as human as ever. My journey for self enlightenment shall continue and I hope my media can help me on my way.

'Saturn' is like my logo. Every brand has one, and I think, we humans, being distinct as we are should have a logo that stands for us. Saturn is my world. It's like my throne, my ideal world, a me that was destined for glory, but life is not meant that way and thus, my entire journey is geared on the narrative to reclaim that lost throne I built for myself as a child with my naïve delusions.

DeAtsu is a family name I came up with. It takes its inspiration from the vision of belonging to a family with a meaning. 'De' means 'from the family of' and 'Atsu' refers to a rekindling flame indicating rebirth. Satsugai means 'a person who kills'. The entire name stands for a vision of a human who dies and is reborn anew to be a better version of himself.

You will see a lot of Subaru when you are dealing with me. It's because he is the character I relate to the most: a very similar character at his core to what I feel like I am as a human. When I see Subaru, I see a 'me' that could have been if I was in his stead. I share a bond with him that feels like a bond a person has with himself. And it makes me feel good about myself and strengthens me and so, I end up liking him more and more.
